title: Closing Desk
oneLiner: Free real estate transaction checklist for agents and transaction coordinators: enter the contract dates, get every deadline and task, share a status link with the client
customer: US real estate agents and independent transaction coordinators handling a few deals a month
revenueModel: Free single transaction; paid tier for unlimited saved transactions, client and agent status links, reminders and team use

paidPrice.product: Nekst Solo Pro at USD 790 a year (about USD 66 a month) plus USD 299 onboarding; the free Solo Lite stops at 5 transactions. About Rs 6,206 a month at 94.2754 INR per USD

searches.note: seodata.dev (Google Ads monthly averages, United States, cached 12 Nov 2026), read 2026-11-27. CPC USD 17 to 37. Similar terms may share Google groups, so the total may be overstated; checklist terms were not measured this cycle.

screen.freeGap: Free options are checklists and capped plans: dotloop and template.net give printable TC checklists (https://dotloop.com/resource-center/downloads/transaction-coordinator-checklists, https://www.template.net/edit-online/283065/real-estate-transaction-coordinator-checklist); Nekst Solo Lite is free for only 5 transactions (https://nekst.com/pricing); Transactly's USD 0 plan charges USD 399 a transaction for coordination (https://transactly.com/pricing); dotloop starts at USD 29 a month (https://www.sourceforge.net/software/real-estate-transaction-management/free-version). Gap: unlimited free deadline checklists from contract dates plus a client status link. Risk: page one held by vendors (Paperless Pipeline, ListedKit, dotloop); contract deadlines vary by state, so the tool must calculate dates the user enters and never advise on contract terms.

evidence.claim: Nekst charges USD 790 a year for Solo Pro with unlimited transactions; its free Solo Lite plan covers only 5 transactions for one user.
Transactly sells transaction coordination at USD 339 to 399 a transaction and mentions a USD 49 a month platform-only plan.
SourceForge lists dotloop from USD 29 a month, Trackxi from USD 39 and Nekst from USD 15 for real estate transaction management.
Paperless Pipeline published articles in June 2026 on the best free transaction coordinator tools and the limits of free plans, showing agents search for free options.
